Quick Start Install npm install -g teamai-cli Team admin / solo user Create a shared-experience repo on your git host (GitHub, GitLab, GitCode, CNB, TGit, or a private Git service), grant write access to team members, then run teamai init https://github.com/yourorg/yourrepo. No team repo yet? Start from a template pre-loaded with production-ready skills, rules, and review agents. Browse the teamai-hub org, click Use this template, then teamai init against your new repo.
